fixes.title: Pastes containing a web image inserted nothing at all
fixes.problem: Pasting any content that included an http(s) image, such as a web article with a photo or RTE content with an uploaded image, silently inserted nothing. All text, links, lists and tables in the paste were lost.
fixes.cause: The `summernote.paste` handler returned early whenever clipboard HTML matched `/]+src=["']https?:\/\//i`, assuming `onImageUpload` would handle the image. That callback only fires for image files, never for `` tags in HTML, so nothing was inserted.
fixes.change: Removed the early return. The HTML now goes through `buildInsertNodes`/`cleanHtml`, which keep loadable http(s) and data: images along with the surrounding content.
tests: image manipulation › http(s) image in pasted HTML survives paste-time cleaning
image manipulation › images nested inside pasted tables and lists are retained
mixed-content pastes › web article with image: text before and after the image, list and link all retained
mixed-content pastes › image directly before a table, table trailing: both retained, caret below the table
mixed-content pastes › multiple tables and images in one paste: all retained in document order
RTE to RTE copy/paste › content containing an uploaded (https) image pastes fully — text and image
web page paste › article containing an https image pastes fully — text, link and image
fixes.shot: mixed-content pastes › web article with image: text before and after the image, list and link all retained

fixes.title: Pastes with embedded base64 images never saved to Appian
fixes.problem: Content pasted with images embedded as data URIs (modern Word, copied RTE content) looked correct in the editor but was never saved, because the images were never uploaded.
fixes.cause: `onImageUpload` only fires for image files. Base64 `` tags inside pasted HTML had no upload path, and `setAppianValue` refuses to save while base64 content exists.
fixes.change: After inserting a paste, the handler scans `.note-editable` for images where `isImageNewBase64` is true (only when `window.connectedSystem` is set). It adds the `loading` class, calls `uploadBase64Img`, swaps in the returned document URL, removes `loading` and calls `setAppianValue`. Sub-100-char data URIs, for which `uploadBase64Img` returns no promise, just have `loading` removed.
tests: mixed-content pastes › Word section with text, embedded image, list and table SAVES to Appian
image manipulation › base64 image in pasted HTML: save waits for the upload, then goes through
RTE to RTE copy/paste › base64 image embedded in copied RTE content is retained and uploaded
paste robustness › pasting text while an image upload is in flight: both survive, save settles once

fixes.title: Multi-line plain text pasted as one run-on line
fixes.problem: Pasting plain text with several lines (Notepad, terminal, PDF viewers) joined all lines together. Text after the caret could also end up in the wrong place, and bullets or paragraphs from PDFs collapsed into one line.
fixes.cause: When the clipboard held only plain text, the handler passed it straight to `DOMParser`, producing a single text node whose newlines collapsed when inserted. Nothing converted newlines into line breaks.
fixes.change:
Plain-text clipboard content (not starting with `<`) is now run through `cleanHtml(clipboardHtml, true)`. Its raw-text branch turns newlines into `
`. If the result contains `
`, it is wrapped in one `

` so `insertNode` inserts it as a single block instead of a bare text/`
` sequence.
tests: paste at cursor position › multi-line plain text pasted mid-paragraph: following text pushed below, caret before it
paste at cursor position › multi-line plain text: spacing correct AND caret ends at the end of the pasted text
RTE to RTE copy/paste › plain-text paste converts newlines to line breaks
PDF paste › multi-paragraph text: all paragraphs retained with line breaks
PDF paste › bulleted list: bullet glyphs and every item retained on separate lines
fixes.shot: paste at cursor position › multi-line plain text pasted mid-paragraph: following text pushed below, caret before it

fixes.title: Word pastes broke sentences with stray line breaks
fixes.problem: Text pasted from Word broke onto new lines wherever Word's source HTML had a newline between inline spans. Shift+Enter hard returns became double line breaks.
fixes.cause:
In `cleanHtml`'s paste-HTML branch (`isPartialHtml && isContentHtml`), `.replace(/\n/g, "
")` turned every source-formatting newline in text into `
`. The handler's first parse pass also dropped whitespace-only text nodes (`node.textContent.trim()`), so real spaces between inline elements were lost.
fixes.change: `cleanHtml` now converts all CR/LF in pasted HTML to a space and no longer strips `>\s+<`. `buildInsertNodes` keeps all text nodes, so spaces between inline elements survive, and drops only whitespace-only nodes next to a block element (`isBlockElement`, `BLOCK_LEVEL_REGEX`) so `insertNode` is not derailed. The Word list regex now also strips lone `\r`.
tests:
MS Word paste › hard returns (Shift+Enter) become a single
, not extra paragraphs
MS Word paste › REGRESSION (original reported bug): source newlines between inline spans stay one sentence
fixes.shot: MS Word paste › REGRESSION (original reported bug): source newlines between inline spans stay one sentence

fixes.title: Script and style contents leaked into pasted text
fixes.problem: Pasting HTML that contained `<script>` or `<style>` blocks left their code as visible text in the editor, for example `window.__pwned = true;`.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml`'s Step 2 tag allowlist removed only the tags themselves, leaving their inner text behind.
fixes.change: A new Step 0 in `cleanHtml` removes `script`, `style`, `iframe`, `object`, `embed` and `noscript` together with their contents (`DANGEROUS_TAGS_PATTERN`), plus lone opening or self-closing forms (`DANGEROUS_TAGS_SELF_CLOSING_PATTERN`).
tests: paste sanitization › script tags are removed with their contents and never execute
fixes.shot: paste sanitization › script tags are removed with their contents and never execute

fixes.title: Unloadable images from Word, Excel and relative URLs got saved
fixes.problem: Images whose source cannot load in a browser (Word/Excel `file:///` temp clip images, relative URLs, `cid:` references) were pasted and saved to Appian as permanently broken images.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml` did not check image sources, so any `` passing the tag allowlist was kept whatever its `src` was.
fixes.change: A new paste-time-only Step 6.5 in `cleanHtml` (gated on `isPartialHtml`) removes `` tags whose `src` is not `http(s):` or `data:`. Stored content rendered or saved without `isPartialHtml` is not affected.
tests: web page paste › relative image URL in pasted HTML is dropped, surrounding text kept
Excel paste › range copied with an embedded chart: table retained, dead temp-file image dropped
MS Word paste › embedded image: surrounding text retained; dead file:/// reference does not reach Appian
fixes.shot: MS Word paste › embedded image: surrounding text retained; dead file:/// reference does not reach Appian

fixes.title: Copied images pasted twice
fixes.problem: Copying an image (for example from a PDF viewer, or an Outlook email with an inline image) and pasting it inserted two copies.
fixes.cause: The clipboard carried both an image file and an HTML flavor. Summernote inserted the file through `onImageUpload`, and the paste handler also inserted the HTML version.
fixes.change: When `clipboardData.files` is non-empty, the handler strips tags, dangerous-tag contents and ` ` from the HTML. If no visible text remains, it returns and leaves the file to `onImageUpload`. If there is text (Outlook), the HTML is still inserted, and its `cid:` image is removed by the Step 6.5 filter, so the image arrives once.
tests: PDF paste › image copied from a PDF viewer pastes exactly once
web page paste › Outlook-style copy (text plus inline image file): the text is not lost
fixes.shot: PDF paste › image copied from a PDF viewer pastes exactly once

fixes.title: Screenshots could be pasted when images were disabled
fixes.problem: With `allowImages` set to false, pasting a screenshot still inserted and uploaded the image.
fixes.cause: `allowImages` only gated the toolbar picture button and HTML-paste cleaning. Image files on the clipboard still reached the `onImageUpload` callback.
fixes.change: `onImageUpload` now returns immediately when `window.allowImages` is false.
tests: image manipulation › screenshot paste is blocked when allowImages is false
fixes.shot: image manipulation › screenshot paste is blocked when allowImages is false

fixes.title: Content after a pasted table landed inside its last cell
fixes.problem: Pasting content where a table is followed by inline content such as an image or text put that content inside the table's last cell instead of below the table, breaking document order.
fixes.cause: `insertNode` leaves the caret inside the new table's last cell, and a range placed after the table normalizes back into the cell. The upstream insert loop did nothing between nodes.
fixes.change:
In the insert loop, when a table is followed by a non-block node, the handler reuses or creates an empty `


` after the table. It collapses the selection inside that paragraph and calls `editor.setLastRange` so the next `insertNode` uses that position.
tests: mixed-content pastes › table pasted INTO existing text with an image following it keeps document order
fixes.shot: mixed-content pastes › table pasted INTO existing text with an image following it keeps document order

fixes.title: Code blocks pasted as a single line
fixes.problem: Code copied from a web page `<pre>` block lost its line breaks, and the lines ran together.
fixes.cause: `<pre>` is not an allowed tag. Once it was stripped, its newline-separated text was flattened and inserted as a bare text sequence.
fixes.change:
`cleanHtml`'s paste-HTML branch converts newlines inside `
` blocks to `
` and wraps each block in `
` before converting the remaining CR/LF to spaces. The wrapper lets `insertNode` keep every line.
tests: web page paste › code block: line breaks inside <pre> content are preserved
fixes.shot: web page paste › code block: line breaks inside <pre> content are preserved

fixes.title: Stray empty paragraphs left behind after pasting
fixes.problem: Pressing Enter then pasting left an extra blank line at the caret. Each paste also added another empty paragraph at the end of the document.
fixes.cause:
The paste handler did not clean up the empty `


` Summernote leaves at the caret or the new trailing empty paragraphs created by inserting blocks.
fixes.change: Before inserting, `findCaretEmptyParagraph` records an empty caret paragraph and `snapshotTrailingEmptyParagraphs` records blank paragraphs already at the end. Afterwards, `removePasteArtifacts` removes the caret paragraph if it is still blank (`hasBlankText`, no img/table/list) and removes only new trailing empty paragraphs (`isEmptyParagraph`), keeping existing ones.
tests: paste empty-paragraph cleanup › Enter-then-paste leaves no stray empty paragraph at the caret
paste empty-paragraph cleanup › repeated pastes do not accumulate trailing empty paragraphs
fixes.shot: paste empty-paragraph cleanup › Enter-then-paste leaves no stray empty paragraph at the caret

fixes.title: Double blank line and stuck caret after a pasted table
fixes.problem: Pasting a table into the middle of content left two blank lines before the following text. After a table paste, the caret appeared stuck on the table edge instead of on the blank line below it.
fixes.cause:
The trailing-table block always inserted a new `


`, even when the split destination paragraph had already left an empty one after the table. The selection was left after the `
`, where browsers draw the caret against the table.
fixes.change: The trailing-table block now reuses `lastNode.nextSibling` if `isEmptyParagraph` is true, and only creates a paragraph otherwise. It then collapses the selection at offset 0 of that paragraph.
tests: paste at cursor position › table pasted mid-content leaves exactly one blank line before the following text
RTE to RTE copy/paste › caret lands on the blank line below a pasted table, ready to type
fixes.shot: paste at cursor position › table pasted mid-content leaves exactly one blank line before the following text

fixes.title: Modern strikethrough formatting lost on paste
fixes.problem: Strikethrough copied from web pages, or applied as `<s>`, was removed on paste, leaving plain text.
fixes.cause: `ALLOWED_TAGS` included only the legacy `strike` tag, so `cleanHtml` stripped `<s>`.
tests: web page paste › modern strikethrough (<s>) copied from a web page is retained
RTE to RTE copy/paste › formatting gauntlet: every format alone and in stacked combinations survives, and saves
fixes.shot: web page paste › modern strikethrough (<s>) copied from a web page is retained

fixes.title: Content-too-big error flashed during every image upload
fixes.problem: While an image was uploading, the maxSize validation error briefly appeared and then disappeared once the upload finished.
fixes.cause: `validate` measured `getEditorContents().length`, which included the uploading image's large base64 data URI, even though base64 is never saved.
fixes.change: Inside the `!isReadOnly()` guard, `validate` now replaces `src="data:..."` and `src='data:...'` with `src=""` before comparing length against `maxSize`. `getEditorContents` stays behind the readOnly guard because it throws in readOnly mode.
tests: editor lifecycle › maxSize validation does not flash while an image uploads

fixes.title: Disallowed unquoted and single-quoted attributes survived cleaning
fixes.problem: Attributes without quotes or with single quotes (common in Word HTML, e.g. `border=1`) were not checked against the attribute allowlist, so disallowed ones were kept.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml`'s Step 3 regex `/([\w-]+)="[^"]+?"/g` matched only double-quoted values. Step 4's style regex lookahead only accepted a closing `"`.
fixes.change: Step 3 now matches double-quoted, single-quoted and unquoted values (`/([\w-]+)=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/g`). Step 4's lookahead accepts either quote character (`["']`). No browser test covers this; the unit test expectation for `c-d="2>>3"` was updated to match.

fixes.title: Multi-line HTML comments leaked through paste cleaning
fixes.problem: HTML comments that span several lines, such as Word's conditional comments, were not removed during cleaning.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml`'s Step 7 used `/<!--.*?-->/g`; `.` does not match newlines.
fixes.change: Step 7 now uses `/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g`. No browser test covers this.

otherChanges: Refactored the inline paste handler into the named helpers `buildInsertNodes`, `isBlockElement`, `hasBlankText`, `isEmptyParagraph`, `findCaretEmptyParagraph`, `snapshotTrailingEmptyParagraphs` and `removePasteArtifacts`, using `parentNode.removeChild` for IE compatibility.
Moved the dangerous-tag regexes and `BLOCK_LEVEL_REGEX` to module-level constants.
Condensed and rewrote comments in the paste handler and `cleanHtml`.
Ran Prettier on `index.js` and the new test files.

Updated unit tests in `cleanHtml.test.js`, `cleanHtml.pasteEnhancements.test.js` and `pasteHandling.test.js` for the new behaviour: newline handling, script/style content stripping, the `<s>` tag, the attribute regex and the removed image early return.
Added unit test file `cleanHtml.imageSources.test.js` (removal of file:///, src-less and javascript: images).
Added handler-level unit test file `pastePlainTextLineBreaks.test.js` (plain-text breaks, whitespace filtering, image-file bail-out, Outlook text, `<pre>`, base64 upload).
